assets.name: Dan Simmons
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: Dan Simmons's existing cartoon team portrait for Saunders Simmons.
Input image 1: edit target, Dan Simmons's current portrait.
Input image 2: Katy's portrait, used ONLY as a reference for how much bare upper arm is visible under the short sleeves at the bottom corners.
Primary request: add small natural skin-coloured sections of Dan Simmons's LEFT and RIGHT upper arms just below his short polo sleeve hems, matching the subtle visible arm slivers in Katy's portrait. Both arms should be visible at the bottom left and bottom right, only about the top few centimetres. End both arms neatly at the same flat bottom crop as Katy's. If necessary bring each sleeve hem slightly up to make room for the small skin strip, but keep the head, face and torso scale/position unchanged.
Constraints: preserve Dan Simmons's existing face, hairstyle, hair colour, glasses, expression, beard, dark navy polo (#172554), collar, white "Saunders Simmons" signature logo, illustrated folds and cartoon style EXACTLY. Keep Dan's darker brown salt-and-pepper hair. Preserve the square canvas, transparent alpha background and existing portrait framing. Do not copy Katy's identity, hair or body into the edit.
Only modify the two sleeve hems as needed and add the small visible upper arm sections beneath them. No elbows, forearms, hands, new pose, full body, enlarged crop, background, props, extra text or watermark. The finished portrait should match Katy's arm visibility and still fit a compact 200px website image.
assets.original_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: cartoon team portrait for the Saunders Simmons corporate website.
Input: likeness reference only. Draw ONLY Dan, the grey-haired man on the LEFT of the photograph.
Primary request: draw Dan as a CLEARLY CARTOON illustrated character, smart and friendly, head and shoulders.
Style: clean 2D comic/editorial cartoon with bold dark navy outlines and broad flat colour shapes. A hand-drawn cartoon character, not a realistic painting or a filtered photo. Simplify the eyes, nose, mouth, ears and hair into clear expressive shapes. Gentle caricature: slightly larger friendly eyes, rounded features and a warm smile. Keep him recognisable through his grey swept hair, black rectangular glasses, face shape and short grey beard.
Rendering rules: use just two or three flat shades for skin and shirt. Hair should be a few simple grey locks and solid shapes. Beard should be a simple light grey shape with minimal marks. Absolutely no photographic skin texture, individual hair strands, detailed wrinkles, realistic pores, gloss, soft photo shading, 3D rendering or photographic detail.
Clothing: smart royal blue (#0063FF) short-sleeve polo shirt, clean collar and two-button placket. Small white "Saunders Simmons" signature logo on his LEFT chest (viewer's right). Elegant light connected script; spell exactly Saunders Simmons. No jacket, tie or white shirt.
Composition: square canvas, centred straight-on head-and-shoulders/upper chest portrait, both shoulders and entire hair included. Friendly relaxed smile. Moderate detail that remains clear as a 200px website portrait.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha. Single person only. No scenery, frames, circles, props, watermarks or extra text.
This is the style master for three matching cartoons. The result must read immediately as a drawn cartoon, much less realistic than a digital portrait.
